decisions.duplicateRule: No semantic merge. D56 section 6.4 permits merged only when the merged row is identical to its target in every normative cell. The 8 Mobile rows are distinct cells and each map row has one locator; they are admitted separately. Touch Target Size stays separate from Target Size (Minimum) (Web WCAG) and Touch Friendly (Web responsive) because the platform and normative cells differ.
decisions.applicability: Keep the batch neutral VPInstruction/v1.2. "Mobile" is source context, not a vocabulary platform token; the H2 vocab has ios/android/web/desktop and no mobile. The platform stays in conditions_applies_when and in the body. No applicator run is required for a neutral instruction.

findings: No Critical or Important findings. All 8 instructions preserve the source cells verbatim.
Minor: the proposal path in the review brief was repo-root .tmp, not packages/powers/.tmp; content was reviewed at the actual path.
Minor: uupm-ux-tap-delay preserves the donor phrase fastclick; D56 section 7 forbids strengthening or weakening, so verbatim preservation is correct.
No Critical or Important findings. Cell hashes, row hashes and locators match the live corpus map.
Minor: the Touch rows use per-row tags instead of the prior deterministic Touch category map; the rationale is recorded per row below.
Minor: uupm-ux-tap-delay preserves the donor fastclick reference; no change permitted by fidelity.
No Critical or Important findings. No collapsed-duplicate or merge error found.
Minor: Back Button, Haptic Feedback and Gesture Conflicts overlap semantically with other donors; D56 section 6.4 does not permit merging non-identical cells.
Minor: proposal path note only; final artifacts are placed in the product instruction and fidelity directories.

aggregation.note: Seven KEEP_ATOMIC Mobile rows are admitted. Touch Target Size (source ordinal 22, line 23) is held: the 280-row disposition marks it HELD_APPLICABILITY because the row labels itself Mobile while its direction and example include Web; three target-specific size candidates require SR-82 applicability resolution. The three SWE-2 protocols reviewed the eight-row proposal; only the seven KEEP_ATOMIC rows are admitted.
